658:t_2:49.en:
$$隼人$$
「Is that the result of $$竜馬$$ drawing out the power of the $$真ゲッター$$ to the fullest?」

658:t_2:51.en:
$$竜馬$$
(That feeling back then... It was different from Stoner or Shine Spark...)

658:t_2:52.en:
$$竜馬$$
(It was as if I'd become completely one with the machine called $$ゲッター$$...)

658:t_2:53.en:
$$竜馬$$
(What was that feeling...? And that power... what on earth was it...?)

658:t_10:4.en:
$$號$$
「$$ＡＧ$$, huh... Did we get some good $$Ｚチップ$$s out of it?」

658:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And how! The exhilaration you felt when you defeated that giant $$インベーダー#pilot$$ produced $$Ｚチップ$$s worth 100 Z!」

658:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll add this to the squad's stock.」

658:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It makes me so happy. With everyone speaking ill of me for collecting $$Ｚチップ$$s, you alone understand, $$號$$.」

658:t_10:9.en:
$$號$$
「That power will lead us to a new stage... That's what I believe.」

658:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Not that I'm one to talk, but this man's very existence is full of mysteries too...)

658:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, well, $$トライア$$... Coming all the way to the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ in the middle of your busy schedule...」

658:t_10:17.en:
$$トライア$$
「Spare me the needless flattery. ...How is the $$Ｚチップ$$ stockpile coming along?」

658:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We've managed to reach the target amount. With this, I believe the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ can bring out the power we want.」

658:t_10:19.en:
$$トライア$$
「Then we'll start getting ready on our end, too.」

658:t_10:20.en:
$$トライア$$
「Though we may not even get the chance to play this trump card...」

658:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There's no point in being negative! At times like this, let's lift our spirits!」

658:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let's give it our all today too!」

658:t_10:24.en:
$$トライア$$
「Heh heh... Try saying it, and it really grows on you.」

658:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes! It's kind of like a magic word!」

659:t_001:2.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「From here on, this space will be ruled by the void.」

659:t_001:5.en:
$n
「But those two aren't dead inside like $$尸空#pilot$$...!」

659:t_001:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It's not those guys who are the void. It's this space that is the void.」

659:t_001:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「I don't really get what you're saying!」

659:t_001:8.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$尸空#pilot$$ draws his power from the void... But normally, that's a part that never comes to the surface, even though it exists inside every human.」

659:t_001:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Because in a sense... it's the same as death.」

659:t_001:10.en:
$$トライア$$
「Death... Something at the opposite pole from life... from living people...」

659:t_001:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It seems $$尸空#pilot$$ and $$尸刻$$ were of a race with the power to guide the souls of the dead.」

659:t_001:12.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That must be why they could activate the $$スフィア$$ of the void, which ordinary humans can't reach.」

659:t_001:13.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「As expected of a $$スフィア・リアクター$$. You seem to grasp a little of the essence of the void... of the Great Void.」

659:t_001:14.en:
$$隼人$$
「The Great Void... Are you saying it's the state of nothingness before the universe began...?」

659:t_001:15.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「We carry in our bodies factors of the Great Void... in other words, of a world governed by laws different from this one's.」

659:t_001:16.en:
$$隼人$$
「So that's why you evolved in the complete opposite direction from humans, even while bathed in $$ゲッター線$$...!」

659:t_002:0.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You guys are ravenous destroyers.」

659:t_002:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「No matter how much power you gain, you're fated to never evolve past being lower life forms driven by urges of hunger and destruction!」

659:t_002:3.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「So you've come, you $$御使い$$!」

659:t_002:4.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「You're the one who called us $$バアル$$ and rigged things so we'd be hostile to other life forms!」

659:t_002:5.en:
$$甲児$$
「So $$隼人$$ guessed right after all!」

659:t_002:6.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「But that's your own fault, you know.」

659:t_002:7.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You got the power of the $$ゲッター線$$ and all, and yet all you ever do is attack every species but your own, purely on instinct.」

659:t_002:8.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You'll never reach the truth like that... In short, $$シンカ$$ is an impossible dream.」

659:t_002:10.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You're destroyers who hunger forever... No matter how much power you have, you can't achieve $$シンカ$$, and in the end you can never become 'gods'.」

659:t_002:11.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Then the role that suits you is 'devil'... which is to say, $$バアル$$.」

659:t_002:12.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「And if you've even taken in the Great Void's factor... the force that seeks to vanish, you're no different from those $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

659:t_002:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A force that seeks to vanish... the opposing concept to the force that seeks to exist...」

659:t_002:14.en:
$$桂$$
「You're saying that thing called the Great Void causes the universe's great collapse once every 120 million years!?」

659:t_002:16.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「You $$御使い$$! Don't think you can do whatever you like with us!」

659:t_002:17.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Ahaha! You sure are bold inside the space of the Great Void!」

659:t_002:18.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Then I'll help you out, so go ahead and try to wipe out the Earthlings!」

659:t_003:0.en:
$$シン$$
「That girl! She called in the $$宇宙怪獣$$!」

659:t_003:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Don't be fooled by how she looks! She's a $$御使い$$ too!」

659:t_003:2.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「That's right. You guys could stand on your heads and still never beat $$テンプティ$$.」

659:t_003:3.en:
$n
「Is that how you get so arrogant and play the ruler!」

659:t_003:4.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「I'm not playing anything. It's just the truth, you know.」

659:t_003:6.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Bye-bye, Earthlings! Think you can beat a tag team of ravenous destroyers and the incarnations of endless destruction!?」

659:t_004:1.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「But this is our chance! Now, at last, our long-cherished wish!」

659:t_005:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「The $$インベーダー#pilot$$s have shown up too!」

659:t_005:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「So it's a full muster of $$バアル$$, is it!」

659:t_005:3.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「Don't call us $$バアル$$!」

659:t_005:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「As long as you keep that attitude, you're $$バアル$$ after all!」

659:t_005:5.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「As long as you keep that attitude, you're $$バアル$$ after all!」

659:t_005:6.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「As long as you keep that attitude, you're $$バアル$$ after all!」

659:t_005:7.en:
$$刹那$$
「We can't coexist with beings that make no attempt to understand others and only spread destruction!」
